name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home before painters arrive?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home before painters arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, some preparation on your part can help streamline the painting process and reduce the overall project time. For interior painting, it's helpful to move small valuable items, fragile décor, and electronics out of the rooms being painted. Larger furniture can often be moved to the center of the room by the painters, but clearing pathways helps. For exterior painting, ensure access around the house is clear, and trim back any overgrown bushes or trees that are directly against the walls. Informing painters of any specific concerns or areas needing extra attention is also beneficial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before painters arrive, clear small items, electronics, and ensure access. Trim exterior bushes if applicable. Discuss any specific concerns.
